name: File dropzone
summary: A calm drop area for statements or documents, with a browse link, the accepted types, and each file's state: uploaded, uploading with progress, or failed with a retry.
use: where people upload documents or statements
a11y: A real file input sits inside the browse label, so keyboard users can pick files; the list is a polite live region, the progress bar has role progressbar with a value, and every remove and retry button names its file.

use_when: a form step that needs several documents, where people must see which ones failed and retry them
avoid_when: attaching a source to a message for an assistant: use ai-composer, which has its own attach button
a long list of uploaded files to search and manage later: use receipts-table

parts.name: intro
parts.what: what happens to the files and where they are kept

parts.name: drop
parts.what: the dashed drop area; its text changes to 'Drop to upload' while a file is dragged over

parts.name: browse
parts.what: a link-styled label holding the real file input

parts.name: types
parts.what: accepted file types and the size limit

parts.name: files
parts.what: one file: type tile, name, size or status, progress bar while uploading, and its buttons

parts.name: meta
parts.what: size and result, progress left, or why it failed

parts.name: remove
parts.what: removes a file or cancels its upload

parts.name: total
parts.what: how many files are uploaded and their total size

empty.how: when the last file is removed the footer says there are no files and focus goes back to the file input

loading.how: a file being uploaded shows a progress bar with its value and the time left

error.how: a failed file gets a red border and tile, the reason in its status line, and a Retry button

disabled.how: set disabled on the file input and dim the drop area, for example once the file limit is reached

overflow.how: the file list grows with every file; past about eight, give the list a max height and its own scroll

long_text.how: a long file name ends in an ellipsis on wider boxes and wraps in a narrow one
long_text.evidence: .odl-name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;

keyboard: Tab reaches the browse link, which holds the real file input, then each file's Retry and Remove buttons
Enter or Space on browse opens the system file picker
After a file is removed, focus moves to the next file's first button, or back to the file input when none are left
